name: Laurea University of Applied Sciences
summary: Applied-sciences university in Espoo and Vantaa; six English bachelor's for 2027 in business, service, nursing, social services and online IT.

ib.text: An IB Diploma makes you eligible. Studyinfo lists the International UAS Exam or Laurea's own exam for each programme; the full 2027 criteria are not yet published.

dates.label: Attachments, including proof of English, due 15:00
International UAS Exam, online from 12:00 Finnish time
International UAS Exam results, at the latest

programmes.name: Business Management
programmes.about: Business for a data-driven market: digital tools for financial and market insight, digital marketing and financial management, with a specialisation in Corporate Financial Management or Digital Marketing.
programmes.ib: International UAS Exam, as listed on Studyinfo; 2027 criteria not yet published. Leppävaara campus.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. In 2026 Laurea chose by the International UAS Exam, not on IB grades.

programmes.name: Service Experience Management
programmes.about: Hospitality, events, food and beverage and tourism, learned through practical projects with companies and service design, combining academic study with the skills the industry expects.
programmes.ib: Selection method for 2027 not yet published: Studyinfo lists no exam for it so far. Leppävaara campus.
programmes.selectionNote: Not yet published: Laurea's 2027 criteria on Studyinfo read 'to be announced', and its 2026 page did not list this programme's method.

programmes.name: Cyber Security, Business Information Technology
programmes.about: Technical, advisory and management skills in cyber security (networks, information security management, security technologies) on a business IT base, studied fully online.
programmes.ib: International UAS Exam, as listed on Studyinfo; 2027 criteria not yet published. Online studies only in 2027.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. In 2026 Laurea chose Business IT students by the International UAS Exam, not on IB grades.

programmes.name: Developing Digital Services, Business Information Technology
programmes.about: IT, business and design combined for building digital services, studied fully online through real development projects with tutor support.
programmes.ib: International UAS Exam, as listed on Studyinfo; 2027 criteria not yet published. Online studies only in 2027.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. In 2026 Laurea chose Business IT students by the International UAS Exam, not on IB grades.

programmes.name: Nursing
programmes.about: Registered-nurse training in English with Finnish support and 90 ECTS of clinical placements, meeting EU requirements so you can work as a nurse across the EU.
programmes.ib: Requires Finnish at B1 and English at B2. Laurea's own entrance exam; Studyinfo says 2027 details are to be announced.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. In 2026 Nursing had Laurea's own entrance exam at Tikkurila; Finnish B1 is required.

programmes.name: Social Services
programmes.about: Social services work taught in English with Finnish built in, functionally bilingual, with three internships worth 45 ECTS; blended study at Tikkurila.
programmes.ib: Requires Finnish at B1 and English at B2. Laurea's own entrance exam; 2027 details to be announced. Blended learning at Tikkurila.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. In 2026 Social Services had Laurea's own entrance exam at Tikkurila; Finnish B1 is required.

notes: Safety, Security and Risk Management is not open in the January 2027 round, and neither are the campus versions of Cyber Security and Developing Digital Services.
Nursing and Social Services are taught in English but both require Finnish at B1 when you apply.
Laurea has not yet published its 2027 deadlines for IB predicted grades or final grades.
